hypothesis: Causal sequences of completed five-minute candle bodies and upper/lower rejection wicks can distinguish absorbed selling from failed upside auctions and predict subsequent leveraged-ETF returns without volume or cross-asset state features.
version_contract: ten economically distinct completed-candle body-and-wick representations times ten decision-and-exit schedules; each version ranks five training thresholds and two causal volatility targets

fit_contract.causality: all OHLC inputs come from completed bars at or before the declared decision bar
